changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION submission_revision_refuse_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'submission_revision is append-only: % refused', TG_OP USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'submission_revision_append_only'; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER submission_revision_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON submission_revision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION submission_revision_refuse_change()
CREATE TRIGGER submission_revision_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON submission_revision FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION submission_revision_refuse_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS submission_revision_no_truncate ON submission_revision
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS submission_revision_append_only ON submission_revision

changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION submission_revision_check_sequence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE head bigint; BEGIN SELECT max(r.version) INTO head FROM submission_revision r WHERE r.submission_id = NEW.submission_id; IF NEW.previous_version IS DISTINCT FROM head THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'submission % revision % names previous version %, but its head is %', NEW.submission_id, NEW.version, coalesce(NEW.previous_version::text, 'none'), coalesce(head::text, 'none') USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'submission_revision_no_gap'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER submission_revision_no_gap BEFORE INSERT ON submission_revision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION submission_revision_check_sequence()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS submission_revision_no_gap ON submission_revision
